'''Cheketta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] former [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. He was sent to [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] in order to guide the [[Balmorran resistance]] in [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|their fight]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was a talented [[Commander/Legends|commander]] but in the end, he was still defeated by a powerful Imperial-aligned individual.

==Behind the scenes==
Cheketta is a NPC in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', acting as the main antagonist of the Imperial Balmorra story. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].

===Gameplay alternatives===
After the player defeats Cheketta, he offers to expose the Republic's involvement in the resistance in exchange for his comrades being spared. Sparing Cheketta grants light side points and Cheketta publicly confesses, leading to riots on Coruscant. Refusing Cheketta's deal grants dark side points and the option for the player to execute Cheketta. Afterwards, the Republic claims that Cheketta and his comrades had gone rogue.
